facts.claim: Pilatus is a mountain excursion near Lucerne, served by mountain railways and cable cars.
The Golden Round Trip combines boat to Alpnachstad, cogwheel railway to Pilatus Kulm, cable car to Fräkmüntegg, gondola to Kriens and bus to Lucerne.
Weggis and Vitznau are lake-side starting points for cable-car or railway routes to Rigi.
facts.sourceLocation: Around the Pilatus: From Weggis or Vitznau ... take a cable car or mountain railway up to the panoramic Rigi.
